clue.text: A flight to go wrong unexpectedly?

explanation.surface: A flight that goes wrong without warning.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight is a journey upward, a trip up into the sky; to stumble or blunder by surprise is the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Household articles whose use requires looking into

definitions.text: Household articles whose use requires looking into

parts.words: Household articles whose use requires looking into
parts.note: looking into reads as investigating, but these articles are literally looked into to see one's reflection

explanation.definitionFit: Reflecting glasses hung in homes are things you gaze into to see yourself.

clue.text: King embraced by a flighty female-a tasty little dish!

indicators.note: the king's letter is held inside the word for the female, as if hugged

parts.note: a coquette is a flirtatious woman
R is the abbreviation for king (Latin rex)

explanation.surface: A monarch hugged by a flirt, then a cheerful exclamation about a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: A croquette is a small fried roll of minced food, a little savoury dish.

clue.text: New plates of the most delicate shade

indicators.note: a new version of the word plates means its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Freshly made dinnerware in the softest colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Palest is the superlative of pale, describing the lightest, most delicate colouring.

clue.text: Italian river fish doing punter's work?

parts.note: the Po is Italy's longest river
the ling is a sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Fishing on an Italian river as though one were a boatman.
explanation.walkthrough: A punter here is someone propelling a punt, a flat boat pushed along with a long pole, not a gambler.
explanation.definitionFit: Pushing a punt along with a pole is the work a punter does.

clue.text: A soft drink consortium catering for trendy music fans?

parts.note: pop is fizzy soft drink
a group is an association of companies, a consortium

explanation.surface: A drinks company syndicate aiming its products at fashionable young listeners.
explanation.definitionFit: A band playing chart music is there to entertain fans of current popular songs.

clue.text: A train that often stops for refreshment and conversation!

explanation.surface: A stopping train serving drinks and chat.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain 'the local' is one's nearby pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopping service calling at every station is a local train; the neighbourhood pub, where one goes for a drink and a chat, is also called this.

clue.text: Agitated shark on a life-saving craft

indicators.note: agitated suggests stirred up, so the letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A thrashing shark lands on a lifeboat.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical vessel built to rescue the animals from the Flood was a craft that saved lives.

clue.text: It finished the stage in America!

definitions.text: It finished the stage in America!

parts.words: It finished the stage in America!
parts.note: stage reads as a theatre, but it means the stagecoach, made obsolete in the US by trains

explanation.definitionFit: The American term for the train line, which put the old coaches out of business.

clue.text: Particular places one gets reorganised

indicators.note: reorganised means the letters are put into a different arrangement

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: Certain venues where a person is relocated.
explanation.definitionFit: Particular and special both mean specific or distinctive.

clue.text: Dark smoke coming from Louisiana

parts.note: smoke here is tobacco, a dark strong variety grown in that state

explanation.definitionFit: Perique is a strong dark pipe tobacco produced in St James Parish, Louisiana.

clue.text: Small and select group of job hunters

definitions.text: Small and select group of job hunters

parts.words: Small and select group of job hunters
parts.note: the description of the few applicants picked out for final interview

explanation.definitionFit: Employers draw up a final reduced list of candidates for a post.

clue.text: It goes round to finish a garment

definitions.text: It goes round to finish a garment

parts.words: It goes round to finish a garment
parts.note: the folded border sewn round a skirt or sleeve edge to finish it off

explanation.definitionFit: A turned-under stitched edge is the finishing border on clothing.

clue.text: Go right through a sort of 19 across meter

indicators.note: a sort of signals that the following letters are made into some variant arrangement

parts.note: the answer to 19 across is a primate, the monkey-like animal

explanation.surface: Pass straight through some kind of instrument measuring a primate.
explanation.definitionFit: To permeate is to spread through or pervade every part.

clue.text: Theatre directors?

parts.note: directors reads as those who stage plays, but here means staff who direct patrons to their seats

explanation.definitionFit: Theatre attendants show people where to sit, directing them.

clue.text: Apply one's flagging energies to the art of signalling?.

definitions.text: Apply one's flagging energies to the art of signalling?

parts.words: Apply one's flagging energies to the art of signalling?
parts.note: flagging reads as tiring, but means waving flags to send messages

explanation.definitionFit: A visual signalling system uses two hand-held flags in set positions.

clue.text: Told off?

parts.note: told off reads as scolded, but told is the old sense of counted, so counted off one by one

explanation.definitionFit: To tell is an old word for to count, so items counted off have been given figures.

clue.text: A label that is child's play to follow

explanation.surface: A tag that is easy enough for a child to follow.
explanation.definitionFit: A tag is a tie-on ticket or label; it is also the chasing game children play, touching one another.

clue.text: His activities may well be cause for apprehension

definitions.text: His activities may well be cause for apprehension

parts.words: His activities may well be cause for apprehension
parts.note: apprehension reads as arrest, as if he were a criminal, but means fear that he spreads

explanation.definitionFit: A scaremonger exaggerates dangers, causing needless worry.

clue.text: A pet with no tail — or with only a short one

definitions.text: A pet with no tail — or with only a short one

indicators.note: the final letter of the word pet is cut off, as a tail is lost

explanation.surface: Describing an animal companion that lacks a tail or has only a stubby one.
explanation.definitionFit: Apes such as gorillas and chimpanzees have no tail, and some primates called apes have short ones.

clue.text: It's bored, perhaps, when a line can't be taken up

definitions.text: It's bored, perhaps, when a line can't be taken up

parts.words: It's bored, perhaps, when a line can't be taken up
parts.note: bored reads as weary, but means drilled through, for a railway that cannot go over a hill

explanation.definitionFit: An underground passage is drilled for a railway that cannot climb over high ground.

clue.text: How many catch up?

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is written from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: to net is to catch, as with fish

explanation.surface: A question asking for a count of the catches taken.
explanation.definitionFit: A number asked for by the question is a figure, here a numeral.

clue.text: One who takes little trouble to move quickly

explanation.surface: Someone lazy who still manages to rush off.
explanation.definitionFit: To scamp work is to do it carelessly, so one who scamps takes little trouble; to scurry or dash off is the verb sense.

clue.text: A ranch seat I can arrange to get

indicators.note: arranging the letters puts them in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone planning to acquire a ranch house seat.
explanation.definitionFit: An estancia is a large cattle estate in South America.

clue.text: Long walking-sticks

parts.note: walking-sticks reads as canes, but these are tall poles one walks on

explanation.definitionFit: Poles with footrests let a person walk raised high above the ground.

clue.text: Still doing nothing?

explanation.surface: Asking whether being motionless is the same as idling.
explanation.definitionFit: Motionless means at rest; resting or idle is the other sense.

clue.text: Though hateful, those who do so should consider a mortgage!

definitions.text: Though hateful, those who do so should consider a mortgage!

parts.words: Though hateful, those who do so should consider a mortgage!
parts.note: split the word into two parts: those who hate paying rent should buy a home instead

explanation.definitionFit: Detestable things are loathsome; split, the word suggests loathing paid tenancy.

clue.text: A lightweight feline

explanation.surface: A small and slight wild cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A small imperial unit of weight is about 28 grams; the snow leopard is also called by this name.

clue.text: The poet in whom Erasmus believed

indicators.note: in tells us the letters are found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: The ancient poet whom the Renaissance scholar Erasmus trusted.
explanation.definitionFit: Homer is the Greek epic poet credited with the Iliad and Odyssey.

clue.text: The passage of art isn't

indicators.note: of here says the answer is made out of these letters, rearranged

explanation.surface: Saying the passage of art doesn't exist.
explanation.definitionFit: Transit is the act of passing or travelling through.

clue.text: Dark fate of the sacked sheriff?

definitions.text: Dark fate of the sacked sheriff?

parts.words: Dark fate of the sacked sheriff?
parts.note: a sacked sheriff loses his badge, becoming without his star, and a night without stars is dark

explanation.definitionFit: A sky without stars is dark; a dismissed lawman is left without his badge.

clue.text: Four Sundays that make an impression about five

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: about means around, so the impression wraps the numeral

parts.note: a dent is an impression or hollow
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: Four Sundays that leave a mark around five.
explanation.definitionFit: The church season before Christmas spans four Sundays.
